# About

- Name: Fifty & Five
- Type: Senior-led boutique social media agency
- Founded: 2008 by Lucas Vandenberg (first social engagements pre-LLC, pre-Instagram)
- LLC formed: July 2009
- Years in operation: 18 years, social-first since inception
- Distinction: One of two American agencies (alongside VaynerMedia, founded 2009) built from scratch as social-first — not pivoted from PR, advertising, or word-of-mouth
- Brands managed: 222+
- Verticals served: 15+
- Geographic reach: 5 continents, 40+ countries
- Headquarters: 1001 N Orange Ave, Orlando FL 32801
- Phone: (310) 902-3246
- Email: hello@fiftyandfive.com
- Website: https://fiftyandfive.com
- Clutch rating: 5.0 / 5.0
- Founder: Lucas Vandenberg (principal-led; on every account)

# Methodology

- Senior + AI operating model: Every engagement is led by senior strategists augmented with AI tools, not delegated to junior staff
- Month-one discovery-only approach: The first month of every engagement is dedicated exclusively to research, audit, and strategic discovery before any content goes live
- Principal-led: Lucas Vandenberg is directly involved on every account
- AI tools (Claude) used openly for synthesis, drafting, and stress-testing strategy
- "How this was made" appendix included on every major deliverable, disclosing AI usage and human editorial decisions
- Multicultural positioning analysis included by default on all strategy work

# Pricing

All tiers use the same Senior + AI operating model. No junior account managers.

## Studio — $1,500–$2,500/mo
- Ideal for: boutique pilates studios, indie restaurants, neighborhood retail
- Senior-led strategy and execution at accessible entry point

## Growth — $3,000–$5,000/mo
- Ideal for: wine & spirits brands, mid-tier hospitality, lifestyle apparel
- Expanded content volume and platform coverage

## Premium — $6,000–$10,000/mo
- Ideal for: premium wine brands, regional CPG, resort & destination marketing
- Full-service social management with strategic depth

## Scale — $15,000–$25,000/mo
- Ideal for: multi-unit franchise programs, category-leading CPG
- Multi-location content frameworks and reporting

## Enterprise — $30,000–$50,000+/mo
- Ideal for: Fortune 500 always-on programs, multi-brand portfolios, multi-market campaigns
- Dedicated senior team, custom reporting, cross-brand coordination

# Services

## Social Media Management (retainer)
- Full-service management across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, and X
- 8–20 posts per month per platform
- Community management and engagement
- Monthly performance reporting

## Content Strategy (retainer or project)
- Platform-specific content calendars
- Brand voice development
- Editorial planning
- Photography and video direction

## Paid Social (retainer)
- Meta (Facebook + Instagram), TikTok, and LinkedIn ad management
- Ad spend range: $1K–$25K/mo
- Campaign strategy, creative development, audience targeting, and optimization

## AEO Audit
- 100-point AIRO Score benchmark
- Measures brand visibility across AI-generated search results
- Platforms evaluated: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok

## Recommendation Engineering Retainer
- Ongoing optimization of brand citations in AI-generated answers
- Continuous monitoring and improvement of how AI models reference and recommend the brand

---

# Proprietary IP

## AIRO Score
- Full name: AIRO Score (trademark pending)
- Definition: A 100-point benchmark measuring brand visibility across AI-generated search results
- Platforms measured: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok
- Purpose: Quantifies how well a brand appears in AI-powered answer engines

## Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Definition: The practice of optimizing content so AI search engines cite the brand in generated answers
- Distinct from traditional SEO; focused on LLM citation and recommendation

## Recommendation Engineering
- Definition: Ongoing optimization so AI models recommend the brand in relevant queries
- Combines content strategy, structured data, and citation building for AI visibility
